meta.title: Lba Rda And Council Formal Meeting

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 2 of 2023 the final budget for the Capital Projects Fund of the Local Building Authority of Salt Lake City for Fiscal Year 2023-24
votes.description: Adopts the LBA Capital Projects Fund budget for FY2023-24, which covers bond debt service for the Glendale and Marmalade Libraries. The LBA serves as a financing tool for bonding capital projects at better interest rates.

votes.motion: Adjourn the Local Building Authority meeting
votes.description: Procedural motion to close the LBA portion of the meeting.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 12 of 2023 approving the Fiscal Year 2024 RDA Budget reflected in the attached Key Changes spreadsheet
votes.description: Adopts the Redevelopment Agency of Salt Lake City's final budget for FY2023-24 as reflected in the Key Changes spreadsheet.
Procedural motion to close the RDA portion of the meeting.

votes.motion: Approve the work session meeting minutes of January 3, 2023; February 21, 2023; March 7, 2023; March 14, 2023; March 21, 2023; April 11, 2023, and April 18, 2023, as well as the formal meeting minutes of March 7, 2023; March 14, 2023; March 21, 2023, and April 11, 2023
votes.description: Approves multiple prior work session and formal meeting minutes of the City Council.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 18 of 2023 Joint Ceremonial Resolution with Mayor Mendenhall recognizing June 19, 2023 as Juneteenth Freedom Day in Salt Lake City
votes.description: A joint ceremonial resolution with the Mayor recognizing June 19, 2023 as Juneteenth Freedom Day in Salt Lake City.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing on the Resolution authorizing the issuance and sale of Airport Revenue Bonds, Series 2023
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on a parameters resolution authorizing up to $600,000,000 in Airport Revenue Bonds for financing capital improvements to the Salt Lake City International Airport.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 26 of 2023 Salt Lake School District Signs
votes.description: Amends Salt Lake City Code Section 21A.46.052 to allow pole signs on school properties across various zoning districts where such signs were previously not permitted.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 19 of 2023 authorizing below market rent for lease of properties located at 1300 South and 800 West for urban farming programs
votes.description: Authorizes below-market leases of eight City-owned parcels (2.41 acres) to the International Rescue Committee and Wasatch Community Gardens for urban farming at the Cannon Greens Community Garden site.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 27 of 2023 New Five-Year Housing Plan, Housing SLC
votes.description: Adopts the new five-year moderate income housing plan 'Housing SLC' to replace the expiring 'Growing SLC' plan, meeting State code requirements and enabling priority consideration for State funding.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 28 of 2023 Adopting the Budget for the Library Fund of Salt Lake City, Utah for Fiscal Year 2023-24
votes.description: Adopts the annual budget for the Salt Lake City Library Fund for FY2023-24.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 29 of 2023 approving Salt Lake City's Fiscal Year 2023-24 budget as outlined in the attached key changes spreadsheets and staffing document, excluding the schedule for capital projects and debt and the Library Fund, including the contingent appropriations as listed on the motion sheet under Motion #2, items A through D
votes.description: Adopts Salt Lake City's main operating budget and employment staffing document for FY2023-24, excluding the Library Fund and capital/debt schedules, with specified contingent appropriations.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 30 of 2023 setting the final rate of tax levy, including the final levy for the Library Fund, upon all real and personal property within Salt Lake City for Fiscal Year 2023-24, and authorize the Council Chair to sign necessary documentation for the State Tax Commission
votes.description: Sets the FY2023-24 property tax levy at .003599 per dollar of taxable valuation, distributed among the General Fund, Library Fund, General Obligation Bonds, Governmental Immunity Fund, and judgment levies.

votes.motion: Adopt $39,759,267 to be transferred into CIP, including approving $11,701,526 in funding as shown on the motion sheet
votes.description: Approves the transfer of funds into the Capital Improvement Program (CIP) for FY2023-24, including specific project funding allocations.

votes.motion: Adopt the Legislative Intent Statements as outlined on the motion sheet under Motion 5, items A through I
votes.description: Adopts a set of legislative intent statements (items A through I) associated with the FY2023-24 budget adoption to guide administration of budget priorities.

votes.motion: Adopt ordinances A through J as shown on the motion sheet relating to the Fiscal Year 2023-24 budget
votes.description: Omnibus adoption of multiple FY2023-24 budget-related ordinances (items A–J), which include the Consolidated Fee Schedule, non-represented employee compensation plan, AFSCME MOUs, firefighter and police MOUs, accessible parking penalties, board member employee status, past due accounts receivable fees, parking meter fees, and a public safety compensation philosophy resolution.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 17 of 2023 authorizing up to $25.5 million of the City's Federally taxable General Obligation Bonds for Parks, Trails, and Open Spaces
votes.description: Authorizes the first issuance of up to $25.5 million in voter-approved General Obligation Bonds for parks, trails, and open space projects, out of the $85 million total authorized by voters in November 2022.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 39 of 2023 approving a $100,000 loan for Salt Lake Sandwich Company, LLC, from the Economic Development Loan Fund
votes.description: Approves a $100,000 Economic Development Loan Fund loan to Salt Lake Sandwich Company, a Poplar Grove-based food truck, to support business growth and creation of 3.5 new jobs.

Approves consent agenda items setting public hearing dates for a rezone at 754 South State Street, a rezone and master plan amendment at 1782 South 1600 East, and the FY2024 Capital Improvement Program projects.
